# Napkin — Visual Whiteboard Skill for Muse

Turns Muse into a visual-thinking partner: say "open a napkin" and it drops a browser-based whiteboard on your desktop (draw, sketch, sticky notes), then reads your work back through a snapshot PNG plus structured clipboard data and responds conversationally — interpreting sketches, groupings, arrows, and emphases like a collaborator, and offering next steps (build on it, turn it into a document, add suggestions). Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: the skill was written for Copilot CLI — it expects a `view` tool for reading images and a bundled `assets/napkin.html` template, so fetch the whole skill folder; Muse can read PNG images itself, but adapt the tool references before relying on the workflow. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
